old_caption: The video depicts a close-up shot of a soccer ball placed under a hydraulic press. The ball is positioned on a yellow and black striped platform, which serves as a protective layer between the ball and the press. The hydraulic press, characterized by its metallic cylinder and black base, remains stationary throughout the sequence. The lighting in the scene highlights the ball's texture and the contrast between the white and black panels. In the background, a pressure gauge is visible, showing a static reading. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the setup of the hydraulic press and the soccer ball.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a close-up shot of a soccer ball placed under a hydraulic press. The ball is positioned on a yellow and black striped platform, which serves as a protective layer between the ball and the press. The hydraulic press, characterized by its metallic cylinder and black base, is slowly descending onto the ball. As the press descends, the ball begins to deform, showing signs of compression and flattening. The lighting in the scene highlights the ball's texture and the contrast between the white and black panels. In the background, a pressure gauge is visible, indicating the increasing pressure applied by the press. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the gradual deformation of the ball under the pressure. The video emphasizes the physical interaction between the hydraulic press and the soccer ball, showcasing the effects of force on an object.
caption: The video depicts a white soccer ball with black star-patterned panels clamped between two yellow-and-black striped platforms, the upper one driven by a polished metal press ram. The setup sits on an orange-topped stand against a plain beige wall with a small hole, beside a fixed circular pressure-gauge inset in the top-right corner. Across the excerpt the metal cylinder and top platform move steadily downward, narrowing the gap between the platforms. The ball's vertical height shrinks while its sides bulge outward, its profile flattening and widening under the load. Stitched seams and printed panels warp with the deformation, yet the ball neither bursts nor collapses in this segment. The lower platform, orange base, wall, and gauge inset stay unchanged, indicating the motion is object deformation, not camera movement. The compression progresses continuously from the first frame to the last, with no release or rupture shown. The viewpoint remains fixed, holding the deforming ball centered throughout.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
